x_lines.source: S-04/S-05 (free west end of the E-D veranda band: B2X beams from grids E-1/D-1 end on a B1 + 2 CN posts). pos printed as '1.00' west of grid 1 on A-04's top chain and again on A-11's WC.1 enlargement chain ('1.00 | grid 1 | 1.80'). S-05 separately prints '1.10' = distance to the beam's OUTER face (beam is 0.20 wide, centreline -1.00, outer face -1.10) -- not a conflict, two different reference faces.

S-04 (dashed B1 under-slab beam E-D at 1.80, east wall of bathroom WC.1). pos printed '1.80' on A-11 WC.1 enlargement chain ('1.00 | grid 1 | 1.80'). Pixel-verified 1.800 m on S-04 (78.75 px/m calibration).
